title: Actual words and maps of the completed projection/base-change diamond
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, actual strict-system operations o, their canonical realization data rho [def-sf-integral-system-realization-data], and a compactified Cartesian square Q [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. Define support as proper image after open extension, exchange as the supplied compactification exchange, target as the tensor pullback comparison followed by the inverse square comparison. Define diamondLeft and diamondRight by the two ordered projection/exchange paths, properFirst/properSecond and commonTranspose by the proper-factor maps, and openFirst/openSecond/openSource by the normalized open maps. Let spaces be the two input schemes, inputs the family (K,L), and word(0),...,word(3) the four actual expression vertices. Define integralLeft and integralRight by conjugating the limit of each system path by the endpoint realization comparisons; define integralSource/Target by word evaluation and rationalLeft/Right by raw constructible localization. OpenLaw and ProperLaw are the two explicit restriction and transpose equations. Statement is the conjunction of the four domains, system diamond, these laws, endpoint constructibility, canonical path witnesses, integral/rational equality, and realization in arbitrary expression contexts. All these definitions are the existing parent definitions verbatim, moved into an interface to avoid a proof dependency cycle.
